So just flight cost. Also maybe need to consider credit card balance? Not needed. We might need to authenticate first? The user didn't provide credentials. We can assume we have an access token? We don't know. We could ask for credentials. But the user didn't give them. Maybe we can proceed assuming we have an access token. But we can't call get_flight_cost without travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. We need to get list of airports. Let's call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then compute total payable amount. That is just the cost returned. So we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then maybe compute_exchange_rate? No, it's already in USD. So just return cost. So we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then output.
